devices.title: Devices
devices.intro: The iPhone clients paired with this household.
devices.column.name: Name
devices.empty.title: No devices paired
devices.empty.description: Pair a new device to give an iPhone access to this household.
devices.failure.title: Could not load devices
devices.failure.unavailable: The Backend-for-Mobile did not answer. Check that the pillar is running.
devices.failure.rateLimited: The Backend-for-Mobile is refusing requests for now. Wait a moment and reload.
devices.failure.refused: The Backend-for-Mobile refused the request. Check that your Cloudflare Access session is still valid.
pairing.title: Pair a new device
pairing.description: Scan this from the POPS app on the handset. The code is shown once and cannot be recovered — if you lose it, mint another.
pairing.expired: That code has expired. Mint another to carry on pairing.
pairing.paired.title: Device paired
pairing.paired.description: The handset redeemed the code and can reach this household now.
pairing.failure.unavailable: The Backend-for-Mobile did not answer, so no code was minted.
pairing.failure.rateLimited: Too many codes minted just now. Wait a moment and try again.
pairing.failure.refused: The Backend-for-Mobile refused to mint a code. Check that your Cloudflare Access session is still valid.
revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revoke.description: This cannot be undone. The handset keeps working until its next request, then loses access for good. Pair it again to restore it.
revoke.failure.unavailable: The Backend-for-Mobile did not answer. The device is still trusted.
revoke.failure.rateLimited: Too many requests just now. The device is still trusted.
revoke.failure.refused: The Backend-for-Mobile refused the request. The device is still trusted.
permissions.title: Permissions for {{name}}
permissions.notSelectable: Unavailable for selection. This value has not been removed.
permissions.defaultExplanation: This device follows the default permissions. Saving creates an explicit selection of every checked permission. Future default changes will not update it.
permissions.selectionCount: {{count}} selected. Every other checked permission is retained.
permissions.unavailable.title: Stored selection cannot be submitted
permissions.unavailable.message: These stored or selected values are unavailable for selection: {{values}}. Saving is blocked so nothing is silently lost.
permissions.failure.read.title: Permissions unavailable
permissions.failure.read.message: The current permissions could not be loaded. No selection has been assumed.
permissions.failure.conflict.title: Permissions need a fresh read
permissions.failure.conflict.message: The server could not accept this grant state. Your selection is kept. Reload current permissions before saving; nothing is automatically reapplied.
permissions.failure.unconfirmed.title: Save not confirmed
permissions.failure.unconfirmed.message: The request may have been applied. Your selection is kept. Discard it and check saved permissions before trying again.
permissions.failure.refused.title: Permissions are not available to edit
permissions.failure.refused.message: Access was refused. Guest or revoked devices cannot be edited. Check your operator session and reload before making changes.
permissions.failure.missing.title: Device unavailable
permissions.failure.missing.message: The device could not be found. No permission changes are confirmed.
permissions.failure.rejected.title: Selection was not accepted
permissions.failure.rejected.message: Your selection is kept. Reload current permissions before trying again.
